newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-ATALANTA UPSET LAZIO TO GAIN SEASON'S FIRST WIN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ATALANTA UPSET LAZIO TO GAIN SEASON'S FIRST WIN.

text.p: Uruguayan Jose Herrera and rising star Filippo Inzaghi both scored on Saturday as Atalanta upset Lazio 2-1 for their first Italian league win this season.

Herrera's goal from close range in the fourth minute set the tone for a match dominated by the Bergamo club, especially at midfield as former Milan winger Gianluigi Lentini found his best form this year.
The long-haired Lentini, on loan from Milan for the season, sowed panic in Lazio's defence with a series of excursions down the left flank where Italy midfielder Diego Fuser offered scant resistance.
Lentini's pinpoint crosses gave Atalanta several other chances to score, but Inzaghi wasted at least two of them and also had a penalty saved by reserve goalkeeper Fernando Orsi in the 20th minute.
The 23-year-old finally found the mark three minutes after the interval, beating Orsi with a 16-metre left-foot shot for his sixth goal of the season, one behind top scorer George Weah of Milan.
The former Parma forward could have made it 3-0 five minutes later when he had Orsi one-on-one, but slipped just before shooting.
Defender Paolo Negro pulled one back in the 74th minute but Atalanta continued to dominate, forcing Lazio's Czech coach Zdenek Zeman to make two substitutions at midfield.
